repo_notes.content: Purpose StreamioX is a controller-first UWP/XAML client for evaluating the Stremio experience on Xbox and Windows hardware, used for browsing catalogs and streaming media via add-ons and torrents.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: What StreamioX is: a controller-first UWP/XAML Stremio client for Xbox with a native Rust torrent bridge. Architecture map and links to child pages.

pages.title: Getting Started & Build Setup
pages.purpose: Prerequisites, solution layout (StreamioX.slnx), csproj/MSBuild targets, Cargo nightly torrent-bridge build, MSIX packaging, signing, launchSettings and deployment to Xbox.

pages.title: Documentation Set & Store Assets
pages.purpose: Guide to docs/ (ARCHITECTURE, PLAYBACK, DEVELOPMENT, TESTING, TROUBLESHOOTING, PHASE-1 plan, store listing, privacy) and the Assets/ tile/logo image set.

pages.title: Application Shell & Infrastructure
pages.purpose: App bootstrap, DI container, navigation and diagnostics — overview linking to children.

pages.title: Startup Lifecycle & Dependency Injection
pages.purpose: App.xaml.cs lifecycle, AppServices/AppServiceCollectionExtensions registration, engine initialization, suspension handling, StartupDiagnostics logging.

pages.title: Navigation & Main Shell
pages.purpose: MainPage shell, top nav, profile flyout, playback chrome, NavigationService/NavigationRoute, MainViewModel commands.

pages.title: Diagnostics & Troubleshooting
pages.purpose: DiagnosticsPage/ViewModel, StartupDiagnostics log files, Diagnostics/ backups, troubleshooting workflow.

pages.title: Stremio Add-on Integration Layer
pages.purpose: How the app talks to Stremio add-ons for catalogs, metadata, streams and auth. Links to children.

pages.title: Add-on Management & Manifests
pages.purpose: AddonService, IAddonService, AddonManifest model, AddonsPage/ViewModel, installed-addons persistence.

pages.title: Catalog, Metadata & Stream Services
pages.purpose: CatalogService, MetadataService, StreamService, StremioClient HTTP transport with retries, MemoryTtlCache.

pages.title: Data Models & JSON Serialization
pages.purpose: Movie, StreamSource, StremioApiRequest, DetailsNavigationRequest, PlaybackRequest and source-generated StremioJsonContext for NativeAOT.

pages.title: Authentication & Account Sync
pages.purpose: AuthService, IAuthService, AuthModels, device-link/QR login, email/authkey login, add-on collection sync.

pages.title: User Interface & Views
pages.purpose: Overview of the XAML views, view models and controller-first UX conventions; links to per-area children.

pages.title: Home, Discover & Search
pages.purpose: HomePage/HomeViewModel hero rows, DiscoverPage catalog grid with genre/type pill filters, SearchPage and SearchViewModel.

pages.title: Details Page & Stream Discovery UI
pages.purpose: DetailsPage layout and code-behind; episode/season pickers, resume cards, available streams list.

pages.title: DetailsViewModel Internals
pages.purpose: Metadata hydration, cancellation tokens, progressive stream discovery, stream scoring, library toggling, torrent bridge routing.

pages.title: Library & Settings Views
pages.purpose: LibraryPage/LibraryViewModel continue-watching grid; SettingsPage and SettingsViewModel (auth, telemetry, server control).

pages.title: Theming, Controls & Xbox Focus
pages.purpose: Themes (Colors, Typography, Controls, XboxFocus), reusable controls (MediaCardControl, HeroBannerControl), converters, FocusHelper, XboxConstants safe area.

pages.title: Playback Pipeline
pages.purpose: End-to-end media playback: stream URL → FFmpegInteropX → MediaPlayer, plus progress persistence. Links to children.

pages.title: FFmpeg Playback Service
pages.purpose: Stream validation/probing, loopback vs external HttpClients, FFmpeg MediaSourceConfig options, header sanitization, error surfacing from native bridge.

pages.title: Player Page & OSD
pages.purpose: PlayerPage XAML and code-behind: OSD auto-hide, gamepad/keyboard input mapping, audio/subtitle track flyouts, resume handling, buffering fallbacks.

pages.title: Library Persistence & Watch Progress
pages.purpose: LibraryService atomic JSON persistence, LibraryEntry/EpisodeProgress models, resume logic, PlayerViewModel state.

pages.title: Native Layer (Rust)
pages.purpose: Overview of native/ components: the torrent bridge DLL and the stream-server/enginefs workspace.

pages.title: Torrent Bridge DLL & C ABI
pages.purpose: lib.rs Axum/Tokio loopback server, /stream/{hash}/{idx} byte-range endpoint, librqbit engine, start/stop/last_error exports, Cargo config and UWP target.

pages.title: Managed Interop: NativeBridge & TorrentBridgeService
pages.purpose: LibraryImport P/Invoke surface, AppContainer-safe DHT/cache directories, ITorrentBridgeService lifecycle and stream URL resolution.

pages.title: stream-server & enginefs Workspace
pages.purpose: The larger Rust stream-server workspace: enginefs backends (librqbit), compat routes, bindings — its role and relation to the torrent bridge.

pages.title: Testing & Tooling
pages.purpose: Test project and scripts — overview with children.

pages.title: Unit Tests & DI Validation
pages.purpose: StreamioX.App.Tests project, DependencyInjectionTests, container validation guarantees.

pages.title: Scripts & Patches
pages.purpose: scripts/test-di.ps1, docs/TESTING.md workflow, streamiox-feature.patch and repo hygiene files.

pages.title: Glossary
pages.purpose: Definitions of StreamioX/Stremio/Xbox-specific terms with code pointers: add-on, manifest, Cinemeta, catalog extra, StreamSource, InfoHash/FileIdx, torrent bridge, librqbit, enginefs, PlaybackIntent, MSIX, NativeAOT, AppContainer, DHT folder, OSD, playback chrome, safe area, XYFocus, device-link flow, MemoryTtlCache, StremioJsonContext, LibraryEntry, continue watching, resume position, proxy headers.
